assessment: This study represents an important advance in connecting bone biology and metabolic functions. It implicates Ksr2 as a key regulator of the switch between adipocytes and osteoblasts that arise from a common precursor. Besides being an actionable target for obesity and osteoporosis, the study reaffirms and provides mechanistic data relating to the human genetic findings on KSR2 variants in metabolic regulation.
